calibration.interpretation: Empirical compatibility ranks require exchangeable complete panels. They are not posterior probabilities of family membership.
calibration.population: Same three enrolled checkpoints, exact fixed probes, same rendering, 24 new token cap, temperature 0.70, top-p 0.90, seeds 4100-4111. Calibration units are whole panels. Held-out sampling seeds test this population; checkpoint and deployment shifts are outside it.

evidence_policy.used: first exposed assistant text per fixed probe and observed segment

routing.limit: Configuration shifts can mimic routing. Segment evidence cannot distinguish a backend replacement from per-request routing.
